Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa neutralize several terrorist groups in Menaka and Kidal
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing the permanent operations of surveillance, control and security of the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . On Friday, November 6, 2026, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, about fifty (50) kilometers southwest of the city of Menaka, a group of terrorists with war materials.

Mali.title: DSSA: Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces on an official visit
Mali.summary: As part of his visits to the structures of the Malian Armed Forces, the Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces (CEMGA), Major General Elisée Jean DAO, accompanied by a delegation, visited the Directorate of the Social Service of the Armed Forces (DSSA) on Thursday, 5 November 2026. Upon his arrival, the Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces and his delegation were welcomed by the Director of the Social Service of the Armed Forces, Colonel-Major Bréhima SAMAKÉ.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Gounzoureye: a community leader kidnapped by Al-Qaeda-linked terrorists, his son reportedly killed
Mali.summary: On April 7, 2024, armed men kidnapped Tami Moudari Touré, a local development figure in Gounzoureye (Gao region). His son was reportedly killed and his daughter allegedly subjected to physical and sexual violence. He remains unaccounted for.

Mali.title: Guinea's refouled crisis: 160,000 people registered, Mali and Burkina Faso are accelerating the...
Mali.summary: Refouled Guinea crisis: 160,000 people registered, Mali and Burkina Faso accelerate repatriation Faced with the massive influx of migrants returned from Guinea's gold mining areas, the Malian Government is moving up a gear. The Prime Minister, Head of Government chaired this Saturday, November 7, 2026, an extraordinary meeting of the Interministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management (CECOGEC) At the heart of the discussions at the CECOGEC meeting was the humanitarian situation of thousands of Africans of six nationalities expelled from Guinea and currently in transit to Mali.

Mali.title: Refouled from Guinea: Mali mobilizes 74 trucks and 21 buses for the repatriation of 15,000 gold miners
Mali.summary: The Prime Minister, Head of Government, chaired, this Saturday, November 7, 2026, an extraordinary meeting of the Interministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management (CECOGEC), devoted to the humanitarian situation of nationals of six nationalities refouled from the gold mining areas in Guinea This meeting made it possible to take stock on evacuation operations, people still present at reception sites and those already sent to Burkina Faso.

Mali.title: Anti-peeling operations in Guinea: 160,000 people returned to Mali
Mali.summary: Mali has been facing an unprecedented influx of people from the Guinean border region of Siguiri for several days, following Conakry's decision to ban illegal artisanal gold mining in several areas of the northeast and to deploy defence and security forces to enforce this measure "As of November 7, 2026, the balance sheet shows about 100,000 people in the Bamako District and nearly 60,000" in the border locality of Kourémalé, announced the Crisis Coordination and Management Center (CECOGEC).

Mali.title: France: Claudy Siar denounces the racism behind the expression "immigrant background"
Mali.summary: In a video published on 7 November on social networks, Claudy Siar, mission manager to Beninese President Romuald Wadagni, speaks in her personal capacity. For him, the expression "from immigration" is "probably the most racist of the moment", because it allows to say of a black or Arab French what one would never say of a white . He says he is sometimes frustrated not to be "in this furnace", and recalls his fight for more than thirty years for human dignity, regardless of skin color, religion or social background.

Mali.title: Anti-peeling operations in Guinea: 160,000 people returned to Mali
Mali.summary: Anti-peening operations in Guinea: 160,000 people turned back to Mali Mali announced on Saturday that it had received about 160,000 people turned back from Guinea after operations conducted by Conakry against illegal gold panning, stating that it had recorded six deaths and expressing concern about a situation of "humanitarian emergency" .

Burkina Faso.title: Bandits Burn 12 Family Members Alive In Zamfara Community
Burkina Faso.summary: Armed bandits have burnt 12 members of the same family to death and abducted an unspecified number of residents during an attack on Gidan Taba village in Maradun Local Government Area of Zamfara State. The attack occurred on Saturday night in Dosara Birnin Kaya Ward, where the assailants reportedly stormed the community and targeted the family of one Mallam Muhammadu Sani.

Burkina Faso.title: Bandits kill 12 family members, abduct others in Zamfara
Burkina Faso.summary: File image of bandits By Idris Salisu, Gusau Armed men suspected to be bandits have killed 12 members of the same family and abducted several residents during an attack on Gidan Taba village in Maradun Local Government Area of Zamfara State. The attack reportedly occurred on Saturday night in Dosara Birnin Kaya Ward, with the assailants setting a room ablaze after the family members reportedly locked themselves inside to avoid being abducted.

Burkina Faso.title: Guinea: 1,263 people arrested in the fight against illegal gold panning in Siguiri
Burkina Faso.summary: Guinea: 1,263 people arrested in the fight against illegal gold mining in Siguiri The operations initiated by the Guinean authorities against the uncontrolled exploitation of gold in the Siguiri region are taking on a new dimension, with the arrest of 1,263 people of seven nationalities, while the campaign to secure the gold zones is causing mass departures of foreign workers and raising concerns humanitarian and diplomatic assistance in the sub-region.

Burkina Faso.title: Guinea/ Fight against illegal gold mining: 1,263 people arrested, including Burkinabe
Burkina Faso.summary: Guinea/ Fight against illegal gold mining: 1,263 people arrested, including Burkinabè The Guinean authorities announce the arrest of 1,263 people of different nationalities, including Burkinabè, in the context of operations against the uncontrolled exploitation of gold in the administrative region of Siguiri . In a joint communiqué dated 7 November 2026, the Ministries of National Defence and Security and Emergency Preparedness indicate that the arrested persons were taken to Conakry for the purposes of the judicial proceedings.

Niger.title: Tinubu condoles with Niger junta leader over father’s death
Niger.summary: President Bola Tinubu has expressed condolences to Niger Republic’s military leader, Abdourahamane Tiani, over the death of his father, Elhadji Hassane. Mr Hassane died on Thursday, 5 November, at the age of 110. In a condolence message issued by presidential spokesperson, Bayo Onanuga, Mr Tinubu said the Nigerian government and people stood in solidarity with Niger during the period of mourning.

Niger.title: Niger: former minister Kalla Moutari still in the gendarmerie, two months after his arrest
Niger.summary: In Niger, Kalla Moutari has just spent more than two months in the gendarmerie of Niamey. The former minister and well-known figure of the PNDS was arrested a few days after the destabilization attempt at the end of August 2026. According to several sources, the man has not yet been brought before a judge .
